title.zh: 第 N 个神奇数字

desc.zh: 从重复的倍数到精确计数，推导保留答案的二分边界。
desc.en: Count overlapping multiples, then derive a binary search that retains the answer.

complexity: O(log(min(a,b)) + log(n*min(a,b))) integer operations; O(1) auxiliary integer cells

concepts.name: Count a union of multiples
concepts.description: Subtract common multiples exactly once using their least common multiple.

concepts.name: First-true integer binary search
concepts.description: Retain the smallest integer whose inclusive count reaches the requested rank.
